q: Do you have a passion for numbers, a sharp analytical mind, and an eye for creating fair, competitive and rewarding employee experiences?
At Boutiqaat, we're looking for a Compensation & Benefits Specialist to join our team and help shape how we attract, reward and retain talent across multiple countries.
You'll play a key role in ensuring our compensation and benefits programs are competitive, equitable, data-driven and aligned with business objectives.
What You Bring to the Table
Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting or a related field.
3–5 years of relevant experience in Compensation & Benefits, compensation administration or HR operations.
Strong knowledge of salary structures, job evaluation, market benchmarking, benefits administration and incentive schemes.
Advanced Excel skills — PivotTables, lookup functions, data validation and analytical reporting are your comfort zone!
Experience with HRIS and payroll systems.
Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and integrity.
Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage.
Regional or multi-country HR experience is a plus.

At Boutiqaat, you won’t just join a company you’ll join a movement redefining e-commerce beauty and lifestyle retail. Here, every day offers new challenges, learning opportunities, and a chance to help build a smarter, more efficient operation from the ground up.
Kickstart your career with hands-on experience, expert mentorship, and real impact.
Apply now and be part of something exciting!
r: Shape Competitive Rewards: Develop salary structures, conduct market benchmarking, evaluate jobs and identify opportunities to strengthen internal equity.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is globally expanding its Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales team, hiring managers, directors, and account managers to broaden reach in mission-critical industries. The successful candidates will focus on our Ubuntu product portfolio, which is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer offering, Ubuntu Core for IoT, provides state-of-the-art security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment, serving global brands in consumer, industrial electronics, automotive, and robotics. We are continually enhancing this portfolio with features like real-time Linux capability and pursuing various certifications, representing Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint. We seek technically skilled professionals familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS.

This is a high-energy role focused on prospecting sales and strategic account development, demanding ambition and focus. You will be responsible for carrying an annual bookings quota and must be comfortable positioning and selling a range of open source, services, and software solutions. Leveraging Ubuntu's market adoption, the work requires actively building trusted and profitable commercial relationships, developing the potential of your territory beyond managing inbound interest. This involves prospecting new business, maintaining existing relationships, and working with colleagues on account strategy. Candidates must be effective in selling complex technical solutions, including enterprise software, cloud, virtualization, and container technologies, to senior levels of the enterprise and departments focused on embedded software and IoT devices. Professional practice, clear account planning, continuous pipeline reporting, and the ability to travel regionally for client engagement and internationally for company events twice a year are expected.
Location: We are growing our sales reach with remote roles in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas; and office based roles in Taipei, Taiwan.
Building and executing a territory sales plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers
Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts

Working with Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction

Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers
Coordinating with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. d: We are looking for an experienced HR Manager to run day-to-day HR operations for a large, site-based construction workforce in Dubai. This is a hands-on operational role, not a technical recruitment position. You will own the employee lifecycle from onboarding to exit, keep the company compliant with UAE and Dubai labor regulations, and build HR policies that fit our company specifically.
q: 10+ years of HR experience, with hands-on HR operations experience in the UAE construction industry
Proven track record managing a large blue-collar workforce
Strong working knowledge of UAE Labor Law and Dubai-specific HR rules
Demonstrated ability to write policies and handbooks tailored to a specific company
Strong communication, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills
Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration or a related field
Oracle HR/ERP experience is a plus
HR certifications (e.g., CIPD, SHRM, HRCI) are a plus, but practical experience and up-to-date knowledge are valued more
Comfortable working on site and in camp environments, and willing to travel locally
r: Manage end-to-end HR operations for head office, project sites and labor camps
Lead onboarding and offboarding, including documentation, visas, labor cards, medical and Emirates ID processes, and clearances
Oversee payroll inputs and salary processing in line with WPS requirements, and calculate end-of-service gratuity and final settlements accurately
Stay current with UAE Labor Law and Dubai-specific regulations and update HR practices whenever rules change
Draft and maintain a company-specific HR policy handbook and roll it out across the workforce
Handle employee relations, grievances, disciplinary matters and labor-related queries for a multicultural blue-collar workforce
Conduct regular site and labor-camp visits to engage with employees, understand concerns and ensure welfare and compliance standards are met
Maintain accurate HR records, leave and attendance tracking, and MIS reporting for management
Coordinate with the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE), immigration and other authorities as required
Advise department heads on HR matters and uphold high standards of integrity and confidentiality
